s: Starting Monday, May 6, the lobby of Parkview Apartments will be closed for renovation.
The work is expected to take about three weeks.
paragraphs.zh: 自五月六日星期一起，公園景公寓的大廳將因整修而關閉。工程預計約需三週。

s: During this time, residents should use the side entrance on Elm Street.
Mail will be delivered to temporary mailboxes next to the elevators.
paragraphs.zh: 這段期間，住戶請使用榆樹街的側門。郵件將投遞到電梯旁的臨時信箱。

s: Work will take place on weekdays between 9 a.m. and 5 p.m., so some noise is unavoidable.
No work will be done on weekends.
paragraphs.zh: 工程於平日上午九點至下午五點進行，因此難免會有一些噪音。週末不施工。

s: We apologize for any inconvenience.
If you have questions, please contact the management office at extension 210.
paragraphs.zh: 造成不便，敬請見諒。如有疑問，請撥分機 210 聯絡管理室。

glossary.en: the work of repairing and improving a building
a person who lives in a place
to bring to a person or place
lasting only for a short time
a phone line inside a building

mcq.q: What is the purpose of the notice?
options: To inform residents about work in the lobby
mcq.en: It tells residents the lobby will be renovated.

mcq.q: How long will the work probably last?
mcq.en: "The work is expected to take about three weeks."

mcq.q: How should residents enter the building?
options: Through the side entrance on Elm Street
mcq.en: They should use the side entrance on Elm Street.

mcq.q: Where will mail be delivered?
options: To temporary mailboxes near the elevators
mcq.zh: 投遞到電梯旁的臨時信箱。
mcq.en: To temporary mailboxes next to the elevators.

mcq.q: The word "unavoidable" in paragraph 3 is closest in meaning to
mcq.en: "Unavoidable" means impossible to prevent.

tf.s: Work will be done on Saturdays.
tf.en: False: no work will be done on weekends.

tf.s: The management office can be reached at extension 210.
The lobby will close on a Monday.

title.text: Re: Catering for the Sales Conference
title.zh: 回覆：業務會議的外燴餐點

s: Thank you for choosing Green Table Catering for your sales conference on June 12.
I am writing to confirm the details of your order.
paragraphs.zh: 感謝您為六月十二日的業務會議選擇綠桌外燴。特此來信確認您訂單的細節。

s: We will provide lunch for eighty guests, including twelve vegetarian meals.
Our staff will arrive at 11 a.m. to set up the tables.
paragraphs.zh: 我們將為八十位來賓提供午餐，其中包括十二份素食餐點。我們的工作人員會在上午十一點抵達布置餐桌。

s: As you requested, coffee and tea will also be served during the afternoon break.
Because your order is over seventy meals, the drinks are free of charge.
paragraphs.zh: 如您所要求，下午休息時間也會供應咖啡和茶。由於您的訂單超過七十份餐點，飲料免費提供。

s: Please let me know the final number of guests by June 5.
Changes made after that date may not be possible.
paragraphs.zh: 請於六月五日前告知最終來賓人數。該日期之後的更改可能無法受理。

glossary.en: providing food and drinks for events
to say that something is certain

mcq.q: Why was the e-mail written?
mcq.zh: 「to confirm the details of your order」。
mcq.en: To confirm the details of the order.

mcq.q: How many vegetarian meals were ordered?
mcq.zh: 八十份中有十二份素食。
mcq.en: Twelve of the eighty meals are vegetarian.

mcq.q: What time will the staff arrive?
mcq.en: At 11 a.m., to set up the tables.

mcq.q: Why are the drinks free?
options: The order is over seventy meals
mcq.en: Because the order is over seventy meals.

mcq.q: What should the customer do by June 5?
options: Give the final number of guests
mcq.zh: 六月五日前告知最終人數。
mcq.en: Give the final number of guests.

tf.s: Lunch will be served to eighty guests.
The conference will take place on June 5.
tf.zh: ×：會議是六月十二日；六月五日是告知人數的期限。
tf.en: False: it is on June 12; June 5 is the deadline for the number.

tf.s: Coffee and tea will be served in the afternoon.

title.text: Your Trip to the Chicago Trade Fair

s: Your flight to Chicago leaves on Tuesday at 7:40 a.m.
Please arrive at the airport at least ninety minutes before departure.
paragraphs.zh: 您飛往芝加哥的班機於星期二上午七點四十分起飛。請至少在起飛前九十分鐘抵達機場。

s: A driver from the hotel will meet you at the arrivals gate and take you directly to the convention center.
Your booth must be ready by 2 p.m.
paragraphs.zh: 飯店的司機會在入境大廳接您，直接送您到會展中心。您的攤位必須在下午兩點前布置完成。

s: You will stay at the Lakeside Hotel for three nights.
Breakfast is included, but dinners should be paid for with your company card.
paragraphs.zh: 您將在湖畔飯店住三晚。房價含早餐，但晚餐請用公司卡支付。

s: Keep all receipts and submit them to the accounting department within a week of your return.
paragraphs.zh: 請保留所有收據，並在回來後一週內交給會計部。

glossary.en: the place where passengers come in
a large building for meetings and shows
a small area for showing products
to have as part of something

mcq.q: When does the flight leave?
mcq.zh: 星期二上午七點四十分。
mcq.en: On Tuesday at 7:40 a.m.

mcq.q: What will the driver do?
options: Take the traveler to the convention center
mcq.en: Take the traveler directly to the convention center.

mcq.q: By what time must the booth be ready?
mcq.en: By 2 p.m.

mcq.q: How should dinners be paid for?
mcq.en: With the company card.

mcq.q: What should the traveler do after returning?
mcq.zh: 一週內把收據交給會計部。
mcq.en: Submit the receipts to the accounting department.

tf.s: The traveler will stay at the hotel for three nights.
Breakfast costs extra at the hotel.
Receipts must be submitted within a month.

s: Because heavy rain is forecast for Saturday, this year's picnic will no longer be held at Riverside Park.
Instead, it will take place in the cafeteria on the first floor.
paragraphs.zh: 由於預報星期六將有大雨，今年的野餐不在河濱公園舉行，改在一樓員工餐廳舉辦。

s: The start time remains the same, 11:30 a.m.
Lunch, games and the prize drawing will all go ahead as planned.
paragraphs.zh: 開始時間不變，仍是上午十一點半。午餐、遊戲和抽獎都會照原定計畫進行。

s: Unfortunately, the boat ride on the river has been canceled.
Employees who paid for tickets will receive a full refund next week.
paragraphs.zh: 很遺憾，河上遊船活動已取消。已付費購票的員工下週會收到全額退款。

s: Family members are still welcome.
Please tell Human Resources by Thursday how many people you will bring.
paragraphs.zh: 仍歡迎家人參加。請在星期四前告知人資部您會帶幾位。

glossary.en: to say what will probably happen

mcq.q: Why was the picnic moved?
mcq.en: Heavy rain is forecast for Saturday.

mcq.q: Where will the picnic be held?
mcq.en: In the cafeteria on the first floor.

mcq.q: What has changed about the start time?
mcq.en: The start time remains the same.

mcq.q: What will happen to people who bought boat tickets?
options: They will get their money back
They must call the boat company
mcq.en: They will receive a full refund.

mcq.q: What should employees tell Human Resources?
options: How many people they will bring
mcq.zh: 星期四前告知會帶幾位。
mcq.en: How many people they will bring.

tf.s: The prize drawing has been canceled.
tf.zh: ×：抽獎照常進行；取消的是遊船。
tf.en: False: the drawing goes ahead; the boat ride is canceled.

tf.s: Employees may bring family members.
tf.en: True: family members are still welcome.

tf.s: The picnic starts at 11:30 a.m.
tf.en: True: the start time is still 11:30 a.m.

s: Thank you for contacting Brightway Electronics about the headphones you ordered online.
We are sorry to hear that the left speaker stopped working.
paragraphs.zh: 感謝您就網購的耳機聯絡亮途電子。很抱歉得知左邊的耳機不響了。

s: Since you bought the item less than thirty days ago, you may return it for a replacement or a full refund.
paragraphs.zh: 由於您購買不到三十天，可以退回並換新品或全額退款。

s: Simply print the attached shipping label and take the package to any post office.
You will not be charged for shipping.
paragraphs.zh: 只要列印附上的寄件標籤，把包裹拿到任何一間郵局即可。您不需支付運費。

s: Once we receive the headphones, a replacement will be sent within three business days.
Refunds usually take five to seven days to appear on your card.
paragraphs.zh: 我們收到耳機後，會在三個工作天內寄出新品。退款通常需要五到七天才會出現在您的卡上。

glossary.en: a new thing that takes the place of an old one
to add to an e-mail or letter
a paper with the address for a package
a day when offices are open

mcq.q: What problem does the customer have?
mcq.en: The left speaker stopped working.

mcq.q: Why can the customer return the item?
options: It was bought less than thirty days ago
The store sent the wrong order
mcq.en: It was bought less than thirty days ago.

mcq.q: What should the customer print?
mcq.en: The attached shipping label.

mcq.q: How much will the customer pay for shipping?
mcq.zh: 「You will not be charged for shipping」。
mcq.en: Nothing: shipping is not charged.

mcq.q: How long does a refund usually take to appear?
mcq.en: Usually five to seven days.

tf.s: The customer bought the headphones in a store.
A replacement will be sent within three business days of receiving the headphones.
The package can be taken to any post office.

s: The Training Department is offering a free workshop on presentation skills for all staff.
It will be held in Conference Room B on Wednesday, March 20, from 2 to 4 p.m.
paragraphs.zh: 訓練部將為全體員工舉辦一場免費的簡報技巧講座。時間是三月二十日星期三下午兩點到四點，地點在 B 會議室。

s: Participants will learn how to organize their ideas, design clear slides and speak with confidence.
Each person will also give a short practice talk.
paragraphs.zh: 參加者將學習如何整理想法、設計清楚的投影片，以及有自信地說話。每個人也會做一段簡短的練習演講。

s: Space is limited to twenty people, so early registration is recommended.
To sign up, complete the online form on the company website.
paragraphs.zh: 名額限二十人，建議儘早報名。報名請填寫公司網站上的線上表單。

s: Managers are encouraged to let their team members attend during working hours.
paragraphs.zh: 鼓勵主管讓組員在上班時間參加。

glossary.en: a meeting for learning a skill
to say something is a good idea
to try to make someone do something

mcq.q: Who can attend the workshop?
mcq.en: It is for all staff.

mcq.q: How long is the workshop?
mcq.zh: 下午兩點到四點，共兩小時。
mcq.en: From 2 to 4 p.m.: two hours.

mcq.q: What will each participant do?
mcq.zh: 每人做一段簡短的練習演講。
mcq.en: Each person will give a short practice talk.

mcq.q: Why is early registration recommended?
mcq.en: Space is limited to twenty people.

mcq.q: How can staff sign up?
options: By filling in an online form
mcq.zh: 填寫公司網站上的線上表單。
mcq.en: By completing the online form on the company website.

tf.s: The workshop costs twenty dollars.
Participants will learn to design slides.
The workshop takes place on a Wednesday.

s: Starting next month, a free shuttle bus will run between Central Station and our office park.
The service is part of our effort to reduce traffic and parking problems.
paragraphs.zh: 從下個月起，一班免費接駁車將往返中央車站與我們的辦公園區。這項服務是我們減少交通與停車問題的措施之一。

s: Buses will leave the station every twenty minutes from 7 to 10 a.m.
In the evening, they will return from 4:30 to 7:30 p.m.
paragraphs.zh: 早上七點到十點，每二十分鐘從車站發一班車。傍晚四點半到七點半則有回程車。

s: To ride the shuttle, simply show your employee ID card to the driver.
Visitors must ask the front desk for a guest pass.
paragraphs.zh: 搭乘接駁車只要向司機出示員工證即可。訪客必須向櫃台索取訪客證。

s: A full timetable will be posted on the staff website next week.
paragraphs.zh: 完整時刻表將於下週公布在員工網站上。

glossary.en: a bus that goes back and forth between two places
an area with many office buildings
a card showing you work for a company
the place where visitors are welcomed
a card that lets a visitor enter
a list of times when buses leave

mcq.q: What is the purpose of the shuttle bus?
options: To take employees to the airport
To reduce traffic and parking problems
mcq.en: To reduce traffic and parking problems.

mcq.q: How often do morning buses leave the station?
mcq.en: Every twenty minutes.

mcq.q: What must employees show to the driver?
mcq.en: Their employee ID card.

mcq.q: How can visitors ride the shuttle?
options: By getting a guest pass from the front desk
mcq.en: They must ask the front desk for a guest pass.

mcq.q: Where will the full timetable be posted?
mcq.en: On the staff website.

tf.s: The shuttle costs two dollars a ride.
Evening buses run from 4:30 to 7:30 p.m.
The shuttle service has already started.

s: This spring, Hartley Insurance is launching a wellness program to help employees stay healthy.
Participation is voluntary, but we hope many of you will join.
paragraphs.zh: 今年春天，哈特利保險推出一項健康計畫，幫助員工保持健康。參加與否自由，但我們希望很多人加入。

s: The program includes weekly yoga classes, free health checks and advice from a nutritionist.
Yoga classes are held in the training room every Tuesday at lunchtime.
paragraphs.zh: 計畫內容包括每週瑜伽課、免費健康檢查和營養師的建議。瑜伽課每週二午餐時間在訓練室上課。

s: Employees who attend at least ten classes will receive a gift card worth fifty dollars.
paragraphs.zh: 參加至少十堂課的員工將獲得價值五十美元的禮物卡。

s: Studies show that healthy workers take fewer sick days and feel more satisfied with their jobs.
We believe the program will benefit everyone.
paragraphs.zh: 研究顯示，健康的員工請病假較少，對工作也更滿意。我們相信這項計畫對每個人都有益。

glossary.en: an expert on food and health
a day off because you are ill

mcq.q: What is the main purpose of the program?
mcq.en: To help employees stay healthy.

mcq.q: The word "voluntary" in paragraph 1 is closest in meaning to
mcq.en: "Voluntary" means done by choice.

mcq.q: When are yoga classes held?
mcq.en: Every Tuesday at lunchtime.

mcq.q: What will employees get for attending ten classes?
mcq.zh: 價值五十美元的禮物卡。
mcq.en: A gift card worth fifty dollars.

mcq.q: According to studies, what is true of healthy workers?
mcq.en: They take fewer sick days.

tf.s: All employees must join the program.
Free health checks are part of the program.
Yoga classes take place in the training room.

items.text: All employees must (1) ＿＿＿＿＿ their identification badges at all times.

tr.zh: 所有員工必須隨時配戴識別證。

questions.zh: must 後面接原形動詞 wear。

items.text: The quarterly report will be sent to all managers (2) ＿＿＿＿＿ Friday.

tr.zh: 季報將在星期五前寄給所有經理。

questions.zh: 「by Friday」：星期五以前（期限）。until 表示持續到某時。

items.text: Ms. Chen was praised for her (3) ＿＿＿＿＿ handling of the customer complaint.

tr.zh: 陳小姐處理客訴的專業手法受到稱讚。

questions.zh: 名詞 handling 前面要用形容詞。

items.text: Because of the heavy rain, the outdoor concert has been (4) ＿＿＿＿＿ until next weekend.

tr.zh: 因為大雨，戶外音樂會延到下週末。

questions.zh: 「延到」下週末 = postponed until。canceled 不會接 until。

items.text: Neither the manager (5) ＿＿＿＿＿ her assistant was available to answer the call.

tr.zh: 經理和她的助理都沒空接電話。

items.text: The new software allows users to complete their tasks more (6) ＿＿＿＿＿ than before.

tr.zh: 新軟體讓使用者比以前更有效率地完成工作。

questions.zh: 修飾動詞 complete 要用副詞。

items.text: Applicants (7) ＿＿＿＿＿ have at least three years of experience will be invited to an interview.

tr.zh: 有至少三年經驗的應徵者會被邀請面試。

questions.zh: 先行詞是人（applicants），在子句中當主詞，用 who。

items.text: The hotel offers a free shuttle service (8) ＿＿＿＿＿ the airport and the city center.

tr.zh: 飯店提供機場和市中心之間的免費接駁。

items.text: If the shipment (9) ＿＿＿＿＿ on time, we would not have missed the deadline.

tr.zh: 如果貨準時到，我們就不會錯過期限。

questions.zh: 與過去事實相反的假設：If + had p.p.，would have p.p.。

items.text: Please review the attached contract (10) ＿＿＿＿＿ and let us know if you have any questions.

tr.zh: 請仔細審閱附件合約，若有問題請告訴我們。

questions.zh: 修飾動詞 review 用副詞 carefully。

items.text:
To: All staff
Subject: Parking garage

Starting Monday, March 4, the parking garage on Elm Street will be closed (11) ＿＿＿＿＿ repairs. The work is expected to take about two weeks. During this time, employees may park in the lot behind the Lincoln Building. A shuttle will run (12) ＿＿＿＿＿ the lot and our main entrance every fifteen minutes. We (13) ＿＿＿＿＿ for any inconvenience. If you have questions, please (14) ＿＿＿＿＿ the facilities office at extension 204.

tr.zh:
收件人：全體員工
主旨：停車場

自 3 月 4 日星期一起，榆樹街的停車場將因維修關閉，工程預計約兩週。這段期間，員工可停在林肯大樓後方的停車場。接駁車每十五分鐘往返該停車場與我們的正門。造成不便，敬請見諒。如有問題，請撥分機 204 聯絡總務處。

questions.zh: 兩地之間往返：between A and B。
主詞 We 後接現在式動詞 apologize。

items.text:
From: Laura Kim <lkim@brightpath.com>
To: Daniel Ortiz <dortiz@ortizprint.com>
Subject: Brochure order

Dear Mr. Ortiz,
Thank you for sending the sample brochures so quickly. Our team was very pleased with the quality of the paper and the colors. We would like to place an order for 2,000 copies. However, we need to make one small change: the phone number on the back page should be 555-0147, not 555-0174. Could you send us a revised proof before printing? We hope to receive the brochures by May 20, in time for our trade show.

Best regards,
Laura Kim
Marketing Director, BrightPath

tr.zh:
寄件人：蘿拉．金
收件人：丹尼爾．奧提茲
主旨：手冊訂單

奧提茲先生您好：
謝謝您這麼快寄來手冊樣本。我們團隊對紙質和顏色都非常滿意。我們想訂 2,000 份。不過要做一個小修改：背面的電話應該是 555-0147，不是 555-0174。印刷前可以寄修改後的校樣給我們嗎？希望能在 5 月 20 日前收到手冊，趕上我們的商展。

蘿拉．金
BrightPath 行銷總監

questions.q: Why did Ms. Kim write the e-mail?
questions.zh: 「We would like to place an order」：她要下訂單。

questions.q: What is mentioned about the sample brochures?
options: They were printed on thin paper.

questions.q: What does Ms. Kim ask Mr. Ortiz to do?
questions.zh: 「印刷前可以寄修改後的校樣嗎？」

items.text:
NOTICE TO ALL TENANTS
The water supply to the building will be shut off on Thursday, June 12, from 9:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m. while new pipes are installed. Please store enough water for your needs before that time. Elevators and electricity will not be affected.
— Westfield Property Management

tr.zh:
全體住戶公告
6 月 12 日星期四上午 9 點到下午 1 點，大樓將停水以安裝新水管。請事先儲存足夠的用水。電梯和電力不受影響。
— 西野物業管理

questions.q: What is the purpose of the notice?
options: To announce a temporary water shutoff
To ask tenants to pay rent

questions.q: What are tenants advised to do?

items.text:
Mark Liu (10:42 A.M.)
Hi, Anna. The client from Sydney just called. Their flight lands at 3 instead of 5.
Anna Brooks (10:44 A.M.)
Oh no. I booked the car for 5. I'll call the company now.
Mark Liu (10:45 A.M.)
Thanks. Also, can you move our meeting with them to tomorrow morning?
Anna Brooks (10:47 A.M.)
Sure. I'll check the conference room schedule.

tr.zh:
劉馬克（上午 10:42）：嗨，安娜。雪梨的客戶剛打來，班機三點到，不是五點。
安娜．布魯克斯（10:44）：糟了，我訂的車是五點。我現在打給車行。
劉馬克（10:45）：謝謝。另外，可以把跟他們的會議改到明天早上嗎？
安娜．布魯克斯（10:47）：好，我查一下會議室的時間表。

questions.q: What problem does Mr. Liu mention?
options: A client's arrival time has changed.
questions.zh: 「班機三點到，不是五點」：抵達時間改了。

questions.q: At 10:44 A.M., what does Ms. Brooks mean when she writes, "Oh no"?
options: She realizes a booking is now wrong.
questions.zh: 她訂的車是五點，時間不對了。
questions.en: Her car booking no longer fits.

items.text:
Local Bakery Expands
Greenleaf Bakery, which opened on Harbor Road ten years ago, will open a second shop on Main Street next month. Owner Sofia Ramos started the business by selling bread at a weekend market. Today the bakery employs twenty-five people and supplies bread to several restaurants in the city. The new shop will be larger than the original and will include a café with seating for forty customers. "Our customers kept asking for a place to sit and enjoy their coffee," Ms. Ramos said. The bakery plans to hire ten new staff members before the opening.

City Opens New Bike Lanes
The city of Riverton has completed fifteen kilometers of new bike lanes connecting the downtown area with the university and the train station. The project took two years and was paid for partly by a national transportation grant. City officials hope the lanes will reduce traffic and encourage people to cycle to work. Early results look promising: a survey last month found that the number of cyclists downtown has risen by thirty percent. Next year, the city plans to add a bike-sharing program with 500 bicycles.

市府開通新自行車道
里佛頓市完成了十五公里的新自行車道，連接市中心、大學和火車站。工程歷時兩年，部分經費來自國家交通補助。市府官員希望自行車道能減少交通量，鼓勵民眾騎車上班。初步結果看來不錯：上個月的調查發現市中心騎車人數增加了百分之三十。明年市府計畫推出有 500 輛腳踏車的共享單車。

items.text:
Remote Work Survey Results
A recent survey of 1,200 office workers found that 65 percent would prefer to work from home at least two days a week. The most common reasons were saving time on commuting and having fewer interruptions. However, many workers also said they missed talking with colleagues in person. Managers who took part in the survey were more cautious: only 40 percent supported working from home regularly, mainly because of concerns about team communication. The researchers suggest that companies try a mix of office and home days.

tr.zh:
遠距工作調查結果
最近一項針對 1,200 名上班族的調查發現，百分之六十五的人希望每週至少在家工作兩天。最常見的理由是省下通勤時間、比較少被打擾。不過，很多人也說想念和同事面對面聊天。參與調查的主管比較保守：只有百分之四十支持固定在家工作，主要擔心團隊溝通。研究者建議公司嘗試辦公室和在家混合的方式。

items.text:
Café Chain Goes Green
BrewHouse, a chain of 120 coffee shops across the region, announced last week that it will stop using disposable cups by the end of next year. Customers who bring their own cups already receive a 20-cent discount, and the company says the number doing so has doubled since January. In addition, BrewHouse plans to introduce a deposit system: customers will pay one dollar for a reusable cup and get the money back when they return it to any branch. The company admits the change will cost more at first but expects to save money in the long term. Several competitors are said to be watching the experiment closely.

tr.zh:
咖啡連鎖店走向環保
在區域內有 120 家店的連鎖咖啡店 BrewHouse 上週宣布，明年底前將停止使用一次性杯子。自帶杯子的顧客已可享 20 分錢折扣，公司說自一月以來這麼做的人數翻了一倍。此外，BrewHouse 計畫推出押金制度：顧客付一美元租用可重複使用的杯子，還到任何分店就退錢。公司承認改變一開始成本較高，但預期長期能省錢。據說好幾家競爭對手正密切關注這項實驗。
